entries.claim: RG115a supplies the full Father-directed Per Dominum ending w020–w040 and Amen w041. The same-edition accented stem and terminal-response typography control accents and the separate response. This does not claim that the proper face prints the whole composite or establish every member’s conclusion in a larger group.

The Collect is the priest's prayer, audible in read Mass and sung in sung Mass; in the bounded sole separately concluded commemoration context it retains a conclusion distinct from the Mass Collect. This claim is not a rule for each member of larger groups.
